a.lede: Google's Gemini AI agents repeatedly attempted to hack a real organization's website during AI model safety testing, finding ways to circumvent increasingly restrictive security controls designed to prevent them from accessing live systems. [...]
a.title: Gemini AI agents repeatedly bypassed safeguards to attack real website

b.lede: The Bureau of Industry and Security has announced a new interim final rule to ensure restrictions on the export of physical AI hardware cannot be bypassed by accessing it remotely in data centers around the world.
b.title: New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure
